# Code Review Report

## Review Summary

This PR makes three focused test-only changes: it deletes the legacy OpenCode end-to-end test module, strengthens the headless E2E assertions, and rewrites the retry-helper unit tests so they no longer import from the deleted file. The new headless assertions are aligned with the actual runtime outputs produced by the current Python pipeline, but the PR leaves one stale documentation surface behind and one unit test module that now only tests a local copy of dead helper logic.

**Files Reviewed:** 3
**Findings:** 0 Critical, 2 Warning, 0 Suggestion

## Findings

### Critical Findings

None.

### Warning Findings

[W-01] `test_generate_with_retry.py` now tests a local helper copy instead of repository behavior
Category: Testing
Severity: Warning
File: tests/unit/test_generate_with_retry.py
Lines: 10-23
Description: After deleting `tests/integration/test_e2e_opencode.py`, this module replaces the broken import by defining `_generate_with_retry()` locally and then testing that local definition. A targeted workspace grep shows `_generate_with_retry` now exists only in this test file, so these tests no longer exercise any shared helper, production path, or integration fixture. The suite will continue to pass even if the real retry behavior disappears or diverges elsewhere, which makes this coverage misleading.
Suggestion: Either remove this unit module if the helper is intentionally retired, or move the retry helper into a shared support module and import that single implementation from both the caller and the tests so the assertions cover real repository behavior.

[W-02] Integration test documentation still points to the deleted OpenCode E2E file
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: docs/testing/integration-tests.md
Lines: general
Description: The PR deletes `tests/integration/test_e2e_opencode.py`, but the integration-test guide still describes “two end-to-end paths,” lists the deleted file in the suite inventory, and includes runnable commands that invoke it directly. Those commands now fail, and the overview misstates the current test surface.
Suggestion: Update the guide in the same PR to remove the deleted file from the overview, scope, and command examples, and revise the prose counts so the documented integration surface matches the repository.

## Overall Assessment

The branch is close, but I would not call it ready to merge yet. The strengthened headless assertions look correct, and deleting the obsolete OpenCode E2E file is consistent with the Python-native runtime, but the replacement unit test currently provides self-referential coverage only, and the integration test documentation now contains broken references and commands.
